purpose: exercise the frozen NATQ-002 validation split
exercise the evaluation harness end to end
establish the preregistered local BM25 comparator for a future SYSTEM-H paired run
prove scoring, metrics, artifact persistence and split handling work before SYSTEM-H is executed elsewhere

ranking_parameters.length_norm: length(coalesce(search_text, text)) / avg_len over the whole snapshot
ranking_parameters.term_matching: binary tsvector presence per chunk, terms OR-ed

system_under_test.top_k_rationale: Depth 10 is the evaluation depth already fixed in NATQ-002-PREREGISTRATION-001; the comparator must be measured at the same depth it will be compared at.
system_under_test.randomness: none anywhere in this system or this evaluation; no seed is required and none is used

metrics.no_new_definitions: Every metric below is one already frozen for this benchmark. No metric is invented here.
metrics.span_hit: a gold span is HIT at depth k if any chunk returned in the top k overlaps [char_start, char_end) in that span's own version_id

reported.name: micro_MRR
reported.definition: mean over all 57 validation gold spans of 1/rank of the first returned chunk hitting that span; 0 if unhit within depth 10
reported.role: primary comparator metric for the future paired test

reported.name: case_hit@10
reported.definition: fraction of the 40 cases with at least one gold span hit in the top 10

reported.name: case_full_coverage@10
reported.definition: fraction of cases with EVERY gold span hit in the top 10

reported.name: span_recall@10
reported.definition: fraction of the 57 gold spans hit in the top 10

reported.name: case_hit@1
reported.definition: fraction of cases with at least one gold span hit at rank 1

reported.name: per_slice_breakdown
reported.definition: the above reported per authoring slice A-E, 8 cases each

reported.name: latency_p50_p95_ms
reported.definition: per-query wall time; reported, never part of any decision

reported.name: case_level_pass_fail_vector
reported.definition: per-case boolean hit@10 in fixed case-id order, persisted for the future paired bootstrap

not_defined_for_this_benchmark.document_hit: NATQ-002 defines no document-level hit metric. None is invented here; gold evidence is span-level and the retrieval unit is the chunk.

decision_rule.statement: This is a baseline/control measurement. It has NO pass/fail threshold and NO SUPPORTED value. The case_hit@10 floors approved in NATQ-002-THRESHOLD-DECISION-001 apply to SYSTEM-H and are NOT applied to BM25. Inventing a release threshold for a control merely to produce a PASS/FAIL would be a fabricated decision.
decision_rule.what_this_run_establishes: the immutable comparator input for a future SYSTEM-H paired bootstrap over cases

prohibitions: The reserve partition is not opened, read, sampled or summarised.
SYSTEM-H's validation-run counter is not incremented; this run is recorded independently.
No SYSTEM-H score is produced, estimated or implied.
BM25 is not tuned; k1 and b are the library defaults and are not swept.
The split is not altered and no case moves between partitions.
No metric definition is added, removed or reinterpreted.
invalidation_conditions: any pinned hash above fails to reproduce at run time
the reserve access log is non-empty
the runner reads any file under evals/splits/natq-002 other than validation.json
